## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] Numbers and URLs live in `dataset.yaml`; prose references them with shortcodes
- [ ] Every changed availability status has dated `evidence` (URL, what you saw, Wayback snapshot if possible)
- [ ] `curation.updated` bumped and your name added to `curation.contributors`
- [ ] Status changed to `discontinued`? Confirmed by a human, with the announcement or first failing snapshot linked
